docs.title: Home
Thuis
docs.text: Download videos from VRT MAX with automatic authentication.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Automatic Login - Authenticate via Playwright browser automation
  • HLS Stream Download - Extract and download HLS streams with FFmpeg
  • DRM Detection - Detects DRM-protected content
  • Simple CLI - Easy-to-use command line interface

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
# Setup (first time)
python thuis.py --setup

# Download a video
python thuis.py "https://www.vrt.be/vrtmax/a-z/thuis/31/thuis-s31a6017/"

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: Requirement Description Python 3.9+ Required for async/await support ffmpeg Required for video download VRT MAX account Required for authentication

docs.title: DRM Protection
docs.text: VRT MAX uses DRM (Digital Rights Management) on some content. The tool detects this and handles it appropriately.

docs.title: How DRM Detection Works
docs.text:
The tool checks the stream URL for specific patterns:

Stream Type URL Pattern Downloadable DRM-free ..._nodrm_... Yes Potentially protected ..._drm_... Usually Yes

docs.title: DRM-free Content
docs.text:
• Videos with _nodrm_ in the URL can be downloaded successfully
  • HLS streams are extracted and processed by FFmpeg

docs.title: Content with _drm_ in URL
docs.text:
• VRT has been phasing out DRM - most content now downloads successfully
  • If download fails, you'll see an error message

docs.title: Note
docs.text: Most on-demand content on VRT MAX is now DRM-free. The _drm_ pattern in URLs doesn't always mean download will fail.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Install the required system dependencies:

# Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt install ffmpeg python3-venv

# macOS
brew install ffmpeg

# Windows
winget install ffmpeg

docs.title: Setup
docs.text:
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Aldo-f/thuis.git
cd thuis

# Create virtual environment
python3 -m venv venv

# Activate virtual environment
source venv/bin/activate  # Linux/Mac
# or: .\venv\Scripts\activate  # Windows

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Install Playwright browsers
playwright install chromium

# Configure credentials
python thuis.py --setup

docs.title: Verify Installation
docs.text:
# Check ffmpeg
ffmpeg -version

# Check Python
python --version

# Run help
python thuis.py --help

docs.title: Run Tests
docs.text:
# Fast tests (default, DRM detection only)
pytest tests/ -v

# All tests including downloads (slow)
pytest tests/ -v -m ""

docs.title: Test URLs
docs.text: Type Program DRM Short DRM-free Flikken Maastricht trailer No Long DRM-free Thuis episode No DRM protected De camping S1 E1 Yes

docs.title: DRM Detection Tests
docs.text: These tests verify that the tool correctly identifies: - DRM-free content (can be downloaded) - DRM-protected content (cannot be downloaded)

docs.title: Download Tests
docs.text:
These tests actually download videos to verify the download functionality works correctly.

!!! warning "Download tests are slow" Download tests can take several minutes to complete.

docs.title: Login fails
docs.text:
Symptom: Authentication fails or browser doesn't proceed past login page.

Solutions:

  1. Check credentials in .env: bash cat .env

  2. Run with debug mode to see what's happening: bash python thuis.py <url> --no-headless

  3. Make sure your VRT MAX subscription is active.

docs.title: Download fails
docs.text:
Symptom: Download starts but fails with an error.

Solutions:

  1. Check if FFmpeg is installed: bash ffmpeg -version

  2. Install FFmpeg if missing: ```bash # Ubuntu/Debian sudo apt install ffmpeg

# macOS brew install ffmpeg ```

  1. Check available disk space.

docs.title: Module not found
docs.text:
Symptom: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'xxx'

Solution:

# Activate virtual environment
source venv/bin/activate

# Reinstall dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

docs.title: Playwright fails to launch
docs.text:
Solution:

# Reinstall Playwright browsers
playwright install chromium

docs.title: DRM Bescherming
docs.text: VRT MAX gebruikt DRM (Digital Rights Management) op sommige content. De tool detecteert dit en handelt het correct af.

docs.title: Hoe DRM Detectie Werkt
docs.text:
De tool controleert de stream URL op specifieke patronen:

Stream Type URL Patroon Downloadbaar DRM-vrij ..._nodrm_... Ja Mogelijk beschermd ..._drm_... Meestal Ja

docs.title: DRM-vrije Content
docs.text:
• Video's met _nodrm_ in de URL kunnen succesvol gedownload worden
  • HLS streams worden geëxtraheerd en verwerkt door FFmpeg

docs.title: Content met _drm_ in URL
docs.text:
• VRT is DRM aan het afbouwen - de meeste content downloadt nu succesvol
  • Als download mislukt, zie je een foutmelding

docs.title: Opmerking
docs.text: De meeste on-demand content op VRT MAX is nu DRM-vrij. Het _drm_ patroon in URL's betekent niet altijd dat downloaden zal mislukken.

# macOS brew install ffmpeg ```

  1. Check beschikbare schijfruimte.
